originality.rationale: The new contribution is the exact K preconditional normal form and 41-operator / 24-orbit enumeration, 25-versus-16 precomplementation representation distinction, four T-operators, and least-cardinality T/F separation. Chen and Holliday define the structures and prove general representation/completeness facts, but do not supply this Boolean table classification. Existing chain enumerations are on incomparable underlying carriers; the already documented two F-operations and older non-Heyting example are explicitly credited. Searches do not prove absolute uniqueness; risks remain.
